verdict:
FLAT INTO THE Q3 PRINT - the triage's DAMAGE-ABSENT call fails on leading indicators in the same filing it cited, and the supply-cliff-has-passed premise fails on the tape it never pulled.

THE CLASS FLIP IS THE STORY. Triage scored this 8/10 court-worthy as DAMAGE-ABSENT on NDR 136% (+7pts YoY) and deferred revenue +44.7% YoY. Red's XBRL decomposition - re-pulled digit-for-digit by blue and spot-verified by me - shows every LEADING metric in the identical filing printing damage-arriving: deferred revenue -$0.9M QoQ against +11% QoQ revenue, RPO +0.7% QoQ, book-to-bill under 1, H1 billings +38.8% vs revenue +47.2%, H2 guided to +32% vs H1's +47%. And the seasonal escape the triage left itself ('could not obtain 3/31/25 DR') is closed: $406,636k at 3/31/25 means Q2-25 BUILT $26.5M where Q2-26 built nothing. Trailing metrics (NDR is 12-month-smoothed; the YoY DR growth is carried by the Q4-25 billing cycle) versus leading metrics is the whole dispute, and the leading ones all point one way. The market's -14.9% ON the print day (08-05 $28.15 to 08-06 $23.97) is most simply read as pricing exactly this.

THE FLOW VETO IS NOT SPENT. The triage's '+6% after the cliff' was measured from the post-print low and conflated two separate red days: the print (-14.9%, 08-06) and the unlock day (08-07, closed down again at $23.29). The final 77.7M-share tranche (verified in the primary 8-K: release on the second trading day after the June-quarter earnings) equals roughly 5 days of post-unlock ADV, with live Form 144s on 08-05/08-07/08-10. Blue's softening fact is fair - ~175M shares traded 08-06 to 08-14 against the 77.7M block with a 66M short-interest covering bid, so absorption may be further along than red's framing - but 'may be absorbed' is not 'spent', and the next FINRA short-interest print is the test. Eligible is not sold; a dated cliff became a standing overhang.

VALUATION, STATED HONESTLY: basic 533.0M shares (455.1M A + 77.9M B, cover page - the triage's 527.5M was wrong), cash $1.667B, zero debt; basic EV ~= $11.9B ~= 8.1x FY26 guided revenue; honest FD includes the 63.2M employee awards, RSAs, the CEO service award, AND the achieved-but-service-vesting price-award tranches, excludes only the unachieved $60-$130-hurdle tranches - call it ~9.5x at the top. At 36-39% guided growth, 84% GAAP GM compressing 518bps YoY on uncapped inference COGS the CFO refuses to bound, SBC at 40% of revenue, and $147.6M/quarter of dilution being DELIVERED, neither 8.1x nor 9.5x is a mispricing claim in either direction - the triage's 'embeds terminal demand destruction' was asserted, never computed, and the burden was the thesis's.

NO SHORT EITHER: 84% GM, +$53.2M quarterly FCF, $1.7B net cash, 36%+ guided growth fails every short-court gate. FLAT, with the sharpest re-court triggers in the batch because the leading indicators that killed the long are equally capable of un-killing it in one quarter.

GATE RULING: the existing ledger gate (alert_below 16.9, basic EV ~= 5x FY26 guide, 're-run the court before the Q3 print') passes only AS a re-court trigger and needs one condition appended: a fill at $16.9 would almost certainly arrive via unlock flow or leading-indicator confirmation - both thesis-worse - so the re-court it triggers must open with the DR/RPO check, not with the multiple. Cheapness on a breaking billings base is not cheapness.
blue_ruling: SUSTAINED (finding 4 REDUCED) - and blue did the two things the doctrine exists for: it re-pulled every contested series digit-for-digit, and it ran the check red had declared impossible, finding the 3/31/25 deferred-revenue datum in the Q2-25 10-Q rollforward and thereby closing the thesis's seasonality escape AGAINST the thesis (Q2-25 built +$26.5M of DR; Q2-26 built -$0.9M - the flatness is a break, not a seasonal trough). I re-fetched both of blue's decisive corrections per doctrine: the Q2-25 10-Q rollforward prints 'Balance, beginning of period $406,636' verbatim - blue's number is exact, not an inference. On the FD correction, my re-fetch of the Q2-26 equity note shows blue itself slightly OVER-corrected: the 2025 CEO Stock Price Award's first three tranches were ACHIEVED during 2025 and are now service-vesting - only the unachieved tranches are uncountable at $25.42 - so the honest FD sits between blue's 611.9M and red's 632.5M, and the honest multiple is a bounded ~8.1x-9.6x range, not any single point.
reopen_gates: DATA (primary re-court trigger, Q3 print ~2026-11-04): deferred-revenue build > +$40M QoQ OR RPO QoQ > +8%, WITH NDR >= 134% - the leading indicators un-break; reopen a LONG court at whatever price prints (blue's sharpened trigger, adopted). Against a Q2-25 comp that built +$26.5M, a Q3 build materially above the prior-year Q3 build is the demand refutation the triage thought it already had.

DATA (flow gate): FINRA short-interest print showing the 66.09M short position substantially covered PLUS price stable >= 3 weeks on sub-15M ADV - the 77.7M block is then absorbed by evidence rather than assumption; removes the flow veto.

DATA: cRPO (12-month) breakout if ever disclosed, or a bounded inference-COGS disclosure / consumption-pricing action - converts the two open unknowns (short-term commitment growth; terminal gross margin) from narrative to arithmetic. Red's mind-changers b and d, kept.
EVENT: any follow-on S-1/424 registration within the 90-180d post-lockup window (lockup_expiration_calendar fired partial) - dated supply supersedes the standing-overhang read; re-court on mechanics.

EVENT: leadership stabilization or further churn - CPO and CMO departures at the moment product differentiation carries the whole moat were sustained-as-PLAUSIBLE by both benches with no independent check; a third senior product/GTM departure upgrades it to a finding.

PRICE (existing ledger gate, kept WITH CONDITION APPENDED): alert_below 16.9 -> re-run the court, opening with the leading-indicator check (DR QoQ, RPO QoQ, billings-vs-revenue) BEFORE any multiple math - a fill there is presumptively flow- or damage-caused and 'cheap' only if the billings base survived.
